records.exact_mechanism: Lexically anchor question terms, document titles, sentences, and entities; retain the complete deterministic two-hop neighborhood; use full-graph fallback when no anchor exists.
records.original_purpose: Gold-free candidate-graph construction with high local recall.
records.evidence_it_worked: Candidate construction is operational and provenance-audited, but no controlled result shows it solves SAGE-QA's composition or 320-cap failures.
records.leakage_reason: Consumes ModelInput question/context and source graph only; gold joins later.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: Question anchoring can remove remote graph material.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace Generator-D admission with modality-specific lexical two-hop graphs and define new cap semantics.

records.exact_mechanism: Reify atomic evidence and graph terms, use typed directed incidence roles and a question node, mean-message-pass for two layers, and score each evidence unit independently.
records.original_purpose: Shared atomic evidence retrieval across ontology and text graphs.
records.evidence_it_worked: Semantic pointwise Family k=3 F1 was 0.659649, but downstream explanation F1 regressed from 0.877193 to 0.850877; no support-set candidate ablation exists.
records.leakage_reason: Inference uses question/candidate graph; gold labels are training-only.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: Typed incidence roles expose graph position and question anchors.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace candidate-subgraph GraphSAGE representation with atomic incidence ranking or invent a new support-set pooling layer.

records.exact_mechanism: Mean logistic softplus over every within-question positive x non-gold atomic-evidence pair; no negative sampling.
records.original_purpose: Improve atomic evidence ordering at small K.
records.evidence_it_worked: Family k=3 F1 0.326316 to 0.529825, but 2Wiki 0.422857 to 0.371429; k=10 F1 and complete recovery regressed on both.
records.leakage_reason: Gold creates TRAIN pairs; inference is gold-free.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace the existing sampled margin workflow with all-pairs logistic training.

records.exact_mechanism: Frozen MiniLM node features plus multi-positive listwise loss logsumexp(all scores) minus mean positive score across a shared two-modality workflow.
records.original_purpose: Jointly improve full-list atomic evidence ranking across modalities.
records.evidence_it_worked: Decision B/mixed: k=3 improved on Family and 2Wiki, but k=10 F1 regressed by 0.008772 and 0.019643; not a loss-only ablation.
records.leakage_reason: Gold is confined to TRAIN loss and post-freeze evaluation.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: Full-list competition may expose more negatives.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Enable a different listwise loss and semantic feature workflow.

records.exact_mechanism: Preserve a frozen top-10 text pool and lexicographically prioritize source-backed complete-chain, continuation, relation, title, original-rank/score, and semantic-similarity features.
records.original_purpose: Move 2Wiki relation-chain witnesses into the first three ranks without changing membership.
records.evidence_it_worked: On 40 reused 2Wiki DEV examples, k=3 F1 0.422857 to 0.682857, complete 5 to 19, paired 25/15/0; top-10 unchanged.
records.leakage_reason: Explicitly rejects gold/answer/support fields and joins gold only after ranking freeze.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: Path membership can sharpen text evidence order.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace or stack the additive text reranker and import a fixed relation parser/extractor.

records.exact_mechanism: Extract conservative typed facts from ten source sentences, execute a unique ordered relation proof, and fall back to a relation-conditioned witness selector on abstention.
records.evidence_it_worked: 40 examples: F1 0.658333 to 0.790417, complete recovery 47.5% to 67.5%, 14/26/0; 27 proofs and 13 fallbacks.
records.leakage_reason: Construction uses question and frozen source sentences; saved manifest joins gold after construction.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: It can select a compact coherent textual proof from an already-good prefix.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace text reranking/aggregation with a fixed 17-relation proof-plus-fallback pipeline.

records.exact_mechanism: Parse an exact formal ASK/SELECT query, ground its target terms, materialize a restricted OWL/RDFS closure, and return asserted source statements for the target derivation.
records.evidence_it_worked: Frozen matched ontology: macro F1 0.554623 versus SAGE-QA 0.337629 on 903 evidence-evaluable questions, delta +0.216994.
records.leakage_reason: Direct use requires the exact benchmark formal query/target; a question-derived replacement is not implemented or validated here.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: An exact target makes proof extraction precise.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Provide a leakage-free predicted formal target and replace ontology reranking/aggregation.

records.exact_mechanism: Hash-question overlap seeds, two-hop relational expansion including relation terms, deterministic distance/overlap ranking, and 128-edge cap.
records.original_purpose: Bound a source graph before QA-GNN reasoning.
records.evidence_it_worked: Family candidate coverage 1.0 on five cases; 2Wiki context-only complete proof coverage only 1/5. No proper admission ablation against SAGE-QA.
records.leakage_reason: Receives question and source graph only.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: Question-local expansion can reduce large graphs.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace Generator-D pre-GNN admission and introduce a new 128-edge cap.

records.exact_mechanism: Train a typed relational GNN with balanced atomic evidence labels; retain top-12 triples and add explicit question-to-triple links for downstream reasoning.
records.original_purpose: Learn question-conditioned working-graph admission before explanation.
records.evidence_it_worked: Five Family cases: linker recall 1.0 and complete coverage 5/5; direct selection F1 0.420 and complete/sufficient 2/5. Top-12 was DEV-selected.
records.leakage_reason: Gold proof edges supervise TRAIN only; inference uses learned scores.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Add an atomic evidence linker and redefine how its top links constrain support candidates.

records.exact_mechanism: For each complete TRAIN proof graph, delete each required gold proof edge, apply balanced graph-sufficiency BCE, and enforce a fixed one-logit margin between the full and deleted graphs; classifier uses only attention-pooled graph evidence.
records.original_purpose: Make graph predictions causally dependent on every required proof edge before explanation.
records.evidence_it_worked: Five Family cases: V1 to V2 proof-sensitive 1/5 to 4/5, explainer F1 0.18 to 0.373333, complete sufficient 1/5 to 2/5; retrieval gate still failed and exact proof stayed 0/5.
records.leakage_reason: Required proof edges are used only to construct TRAIN supervision; inference is gold-free.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: It directly increases exposure to complete-versus-incomplete contrasts.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Add synthetic edge-deletion candidates, a graph-sufficiency head, and a new necessity-margin loss.

records.exact_mechanism: Multi-head messages conditioned on edge direction, evidence semantic type, source/target node types, and question, followed by question-attention pooling over evidence.
records.original_purpose: Improve typed multi-hop proof reasoning beyond mean message passing.
records.evidence_it_worked: Negative: V3 versus V2 on five Family cases reduced complete proof recall 0.4 to 0.2, positive deletion 0.8 to 0.6, and explainer F1 0.373333 to 0.1.
records.leakage_reason: Inference features are question and context graph only.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: It is relation-aware and candidate-aware through pooled evidence.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Replace GraphSAGE layers, add semantic edge types, and replace mean candidate pooling.

records.exact_mechanism: Post-hoc PyG GNNExplainer masks or dataset-trained GraphMask gates mapped back to evidence nodes/edges, followed by connected subgraph selection.
records.original_purpose: Extract inference-time explanatory subgraphs faithful to a trained GNN.
records.evidence_it_worked: Negative across repositories: direct learned links beat GNNExplainer 0.420 to 0.080 F1; counterfactual GraphMask F1 0.0; NeSyGR-QA explainer diagnostics failed predeclared gates.
records.leakage_reason: Model explanations can be generated without gold; gold is evaluation-only.
records.why_it_could_help_sageqa: A faithful mask could select a coherent subgraph.
records.required_sageqa_changes: Add expensive per-example explanation or train a masking network and redefine aggregation.
